title: Fed June FOMC Minutes Signal Hawkish Shift; 9 Officials Project Rate Hike in 2026
summary: Minutes released July 8 show Fed removed earlier hints of rate cuts and shifted focus to persistent inflation. Nine members project at least one hike in 2026; core PCE forecast raised to 3.3%. Market-implied odds of July 29 hike at ~20%.
why: 联储会议纪要鹰派超预期，利率维持3.50-3.75%不变但加息预期重燃，直接影响sell put策略的期权隐含波动率定价与市场风险偏好。

title: US June Payrolls Miss Badly: Only 57,000 Jobs Added vs. 115,000 Forecast
summary: Weakest monthly payroll gain in months, with April-May revised down by a combined 74,000. Unemployment fell to 4.2% due to a drop in labor force participation rate to 61.5%, the lowest since March 2021. Rate hike odds sharply reduced.
why: 就业大幅不及预期令市场加息预期降温，对风险资产短期利好，但整体经济走弱信号值得关注，sell put策略行权风险下降。

title: SpaceX Joins Nasdaq-100 on July 7 in Fastest Major Index Inclusion After IPO
summary: SpaceX (SPCX) entered Nasdaq-100 just 15 trading days after its June 12 IPO at $135/share and $1.75T valuation, enabled by Nasdaq's revised fast-entry rules. QQQ/QQQM forced to buy; S&P 500 inclusion requires profitability not met until at least mid-2027.
why: SpaceX入Nasdaq-100将触发ETF大规模被动买入，压缩指数内其他权重股空间；同时确认科技/国防AI赛道持续吸引巨额资金。

title: Apple Supplier Luxshare Slips Over 5% in Hong Kong Debut After Record HK$24.3B IPO
summary: Luxshare Precision (Apple AirPods/iPhone assembler) fell as much as 9.6% on first day July 9, trading near HK$60 vs. IPO price HK$63.28 — the top of its range. The deal was HK's largest listing of 2026 (US$3.1B), backed by Temasek and GIC.
why: 港股最大IPO首日破发，反映港股申购资金流失和投资者短期抛售压力，可观察港股市场IPO吸引力与整体流动性；与持仓个股无直接关联，但影响大盘情绪。

title: Oil Surges Over 5% as US-Iran Tensions Reignite; Trump Declares Ceasefire 'Over'
summary: WTI crude surged to ~$74/bbl and Brent to ~$77.7 on Wednesday July 8 after President Trump declared the interim Iran ceasefire 'over' and threatened new blockades on Hormuz. Energy sector outperformed; inflation expectations reset upward, weighing on growth stocks.
why: 油价急涨强化通胀预期，对联储鹰派信号构成叠加效应，压制成长股估值；同时能源板块短期受益，需关注对持仓科技/消费股的情绪传导。

title: Gold Retreats to $4,050 on Middle East Flare-Up and Revived Hike Fears After Touching $4,200
summary: Spot gold fell over 1% to $4,050/oz on July 8 — monthly low — as oil surge reignited inflation fears and hawkish Fed signals dampened rate-cut hopes. Gold had rallied above $4,100 after the June payroll miss but reversed on geopolitical escalation.
why: 金价高位回调压制老铺黄金（6181.HK）等黄金概念股短期情绪；同时高通胀维持令Fed降息时间表延后，宏观背景偏不利于长久期资产。

title: Alibaba Agrees to $600M DOJ Non-Prosecution Deal Over Illegal Drug Marketplace Sales; Stock Surges 11%
summary: Alibaba and Ant Group unit AUS Merchant Services will pay $600M to resolve 8-year DOJ probe: $125M criminal penalty + $200M forfeiture (BABA), $85M + $190M (AUS). Non-prosecution agreement means no conviction. BABA stock jumped 11.06% on July 8.
why: 法律悬顶正式落地为可计算成本（而非开放性不确定性），解除对美国合规业务的影响，利好BABA估值重估；期权卖方可关注IV回落后sell put机会。

title: Tencent Sells $1.5B Kuaishou Stake While BAT Alliance Pours $2.8B into Kling AI at $18B Valuation
summary: Tencent sold ~273M Kuaishou shares via block trade (stake cut to 9.37%), raising HK$10B+. Simultaneously, Tencent, Alibaba, and Baidu joined 36 investors in a $2.8B round for Kuaishou's Kling AI spin-off at $18B post-money valuation to counter ByteDance. Kling AI ARR now $500M.
why: 腾讯减持快手反映持续降低非核心权益，同时联合BAT共投Kling AI体现AI视频生成战略布局；后者若成功出圈将为腾讯生态带来AI协同价值，亦体现其AI赛道防御姿态。

title: SK Hynix Lists on Nasdaq July 10 (SKHY) in Record $29B Foreign Company ADR Offering
summary: SK Hynix will debut on Nasdaq tomorrow, raising up to ~$29B — largest-ever U.S. listing by a foreign firm. Proceeds fund Yongin Cluster fab (₩31T), advanced HBM packaging (₩19T), and EUV equipment. Hynix holds 56.4% global HBM revenue share as of Q1 2026.
why: SK海力士ADR上市将大幅提升HBM板块在美资本市场能见度，同时冲击对持有CSOP南方两倍做多SK海力士ETF的投资者；明日上市需关注定价区间和开盘溢价。

title: Xiaomi Unveils 'Sky Nomad' EREV SUV Series (Pengcheng), Enters Extended-Range EV Market
summary: CEO Lei Jun announced Xiaomi's new Pengcheng (澎城) SUV series on July 9, branded 'Sky Nomad,' pitching 'smart, versatile, spacious' SUVs as Chinese alternative to Tesla Model Y. EREV uses combustion engine as range extender. YU7 has delivered 258,232 units since June 2025 launch.
why: 小米今日发布全新增程SUV，进一步丰富汽车产品矩阵，正面迎战特斯拉；新品能否获取订单将验证汽车业务增量空间，影响1810.HK中期估值逻辑。

title: Futu Holdings Hit With RMB1.85B (~$271M) CSRC Penalty for Unlicensed Mainland Business; Stock Fell 27%
summary: China's CSRC proposed to confiscate illegal proceeds and impose fines totaling RMB1.85B on Futu entities for conducting securities, fund sales, and futures business in mainland China without required licenses. CEO Li Hua faces RMB1.25M personal fine. Multiple securities class-action lawsuits filed.
why: 富途遭重罚暴露在中国境内无证经营风险，股价已跌逾27%；若持有FUTU期权，需评估IV和行权价风险；该罚款为历史性监管风险，对互联网券商赛道构成系统性负面影响。

title: Tesla Robotaxi Expands to Miami; Q2 Deliveries Beat at ~480K; NHTSA Closes FSD Safety Probe
summary: Tesla launched driverless Robotaxi service in Miami on July 3 — first city outside Texas/California. Q2 deliveries ~480,000 beat highest estimates by 60,000+; energy storage hit 13.5 GWh. NHTSA closed Model 3/Y unexpected braking investigation following software fixes.
why: Robotaxi扩城+Q2交付超预期是TSLA中期核心催化剂，FSD安全调查关闭降低监管风险；持有TSLA的投资者可关注7月22日Q2财报是否进一步确认盈利能力。

title: Alphabet Joins Dow Jones Index; Gemini Hits 900M MAU; Google Cloud Q1 Revenue +63% to $20B
summary: Alphabet replaced Verizon in the Dow Jones Industrial Average; stock rose ~4% on inclusion day. Gemini monthly active users exceeded 900M across 230 countries. Google Cloud Q1 revenue hit $20B (+63% YoY) with backlog nearly doubled to $462B. 2026 capex guided $180-190B.
why: Alphabet入道指+Gemini量产规模确认其AI平台主导地位；但云容量受限（Gemini向Meta限供）令短期增长受阻；持有GOOGL者可关注Q2财报及云增速是否重回轨道。

title: Intel Stock Crashes 21% in 7 Days on 18A Yield Concerns and Foundry Losses
summary: INTC fell from ~$140 to ~$110 between June 30-July 8, driven by reports that 18A profitable yields may not arrive until late 2026-2027, and Q1 Intel Foundry external revenue was only $174M with large losses. Intel 18A-P entered risk production with 9% perf improvement.
why: 英特尔代工良率推迟担忧令估值承压；若持有INTC或衍生品，需密切关注7月23日Q2财报确认良率进展；18A-P入风险产线是积极信号但尚未扭转市场情绪。

title: Nvidia Refutes Kyber NVL144 Delay; Goldman Sees 21.7x PE as 'Compelling' Near S&P Average
summary: NVDA shares gained 1%+ after the company denied reports that its Kyber NVL144 AI system would be delayed to 2028. Goldman Sachs analyst flagged NVDA's 21.7x forward P/E is near S&P 500 average and well below its 5-year average of 72x. $119B in supply commitments secured.
why: 英伟达主动否认产品延迟稳定市场信心；高盛低估值论点若被市场接受，可能推动NVDA估值重估；持有或计划sell put NVDA者可关注Q2财报（预计8月）验证数据中心需求。

title: Circle (CRCL) Faces July 18 GENIUS Act Compliance Deadline; Fed Rules Imminent for USDC Issuers
summary: The GENIUS Act's one-year transition expires July 18, with Fed/Treasury required to release stablecoin issuer rules. Stricter reserve, capital, or licensing standards could impact USDC issuer Circle. CRCL stock fell ~2.8% on July 8 amid geopolitical risk aversion.
why: GENIUS法案落地将正式确立Circle USDC的监管框架，规则宽严直接影响CRCL盈利结构；7月18日前后为关键催化时间窗口，卖期权者需注意事件驱动IV波动。

title: Temu Owner PDD Hit by Government Raids in Ireland and China Over Alleged Subsidy Fraud
summary: Investigators raided Temu/Pinduoduo (PDD) facilities in Ireland and Shanghai probing alleged subsidy fraud. The US has formally eliminated the de minimis exemption, eroding Temu's cost advantage. PDD Q1 2026 revenue grew 11% YoY to RMB106.2B but faces dual margin headwinds.
why: Temu遭双管齐下（补贴欺诈调查+de minimis取消），进一步压制跨境电商利润率；若调查深化将对PDD估值构成重大负面影响，持有或卖put PDD需高度警惕。

title: SanDisk (SNDK) Q3 Revenue Surges 251% YoY to $6B; Gross Margin at 78.4%; Best S&P 500 Performer H1 2026
summary: SanDisk reported record Q3 revenue of $6B (+251% YoY) with gross margin of 78.4% as AI-driven NAND demand tightened supply globally. Company began sampling BiCS10 1Tb TLC NAND on July 2. Stock was the top S&P 500 performer in H1 2026. Next earnings: Aug 24.
why: SanDisk NAND业绩超预期印证AI算力基础设施对存储的强劲需求，间接利好美光（MU）和SK海力士的DRAM/HBM估值逻辑；可关注SNDK是否为sell put标的。

title: Walmart and Sam's Club Launch Major Summer Price Cuts Across Thousands of Items
summary: Walmart and Sam's Club announced thousands of summer rollbacks on beef, produce, beverages, grills, pools, toys, and apparel. Sam's Club Q1 e-commerce sales +23% YoY with club-fulfilled delivery +90%. Move driven by consumer price sensitivity amid elevated inflation.
why: 沃尔玛大规模降价是应对消费者价格敏感度上升的战略举措，表明零售端价格压力持续；山姆电商高增长支撑中期估值，但降价策略可能短期压缩毛利率。
